TEST ASSIGNMENT · 2026

GreenDent

Dental website header and hero with responsive layouts and two themes.

Test assignment

Design a dental clinic website header and hero. I developed the GreenDent name and visual direction, light and dark themes, and layouts for 1440, 768 and 390-pixel widths.

Additional implementation

An HTML, CSS and JavaScript browser prototype with automatic and manual theme switching, a mobile menu and a demo booking notice. Additional pages show illustrative service prices and insurance information.

This is an unpaid test assignment, not a commission for an operating clinic. GreenDent is fictional, booking is unavailable and no personal data is collected. Photo: Anna Shvets, Pexels, no.3845810. Illustrative prices include a source link.
